resources.string: Here\'s what actually happens with your family\'s information.
Your family profile — display name, age groups, and preferences — is stored only on this device.
Completed quests and your family\'s progress are stored only on this device.
Photos and voice memories you save stay private on this device. Togetherly never uploads them anywhere.

RevenueCat, our subscription provider, receives purchase-related identifiers and transaction information to manage Family Plus. Payments themselves are processed by the App Store or Google Play, not by Togetherly directly.
Reminder notifications are scheduled on this device — Togetherly has no server that sends them.
Togetherly doesn\'t currently have accounts or cloud sync — there\'s nothing to sign into, and nothing syncs across devices.
Uninstalling Togetherly may remove its local data, depending on your device\'s own backup and storage settings.
Your purchase history may still be recoverable through the App Store or Google Play, separately from anything stored in the app.
